'''Tenjin Shrine''' (天神神社) is a shrine dedicated to the {{ill|Tenjin faith|ja|天神信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenjin faith|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenjin faith|comment=enwiki is a redirect}}, often worshiping {{ill|Sugawara no Michizane|2=ja|3=菅原道真|ja|Sugawara no Michizane|2=ja|3=菅原道真|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sugawara no Michizane|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q382005}} as the deity.
